items.question: How does the clinic waitlist work?
items.answer: The waitlist allows you to wait for a full day or slot with a doctor [FAQ-000029]. You can join the waitlist when your desired slot or day is full, with a limit of one open entry per doctor and day [FAQ-000030]. When a slot becomes available, the next patient on the list receives an offer [FAQ-000029]. You will be notified of an offer via the bell icon and in "My Appointments" [FAQ-000031, FAQ-000039]. You have 120 minutes to accept the offer in "My Appointments" [FAQ-000032, FAQ-000039]. If you do not accept within this time, the offer expires and passes to the next patient [FAQ-000032].
items.score_reason: position and context cover all aspects of how the waitlist works, and all claims in the answer are fully supported by the retrieved contexts.

items.question: Is the AI assistant a replacement for medical advice from a doctor?
items.answer: No, the AI assistant is not a replacement for medical advice from a doctor. The assistant provides only general information and specialization guidance [FAQ-000067, FAQ-000115, FAQ-000073]. It does not diagnose conditions [FAQ-000067]. Furthermore, the assistant cannot change prescriptions, as only your doctor has the authority to do so [FAQ-000046]. Any guidance provided is not medical advice, and a doctor will perform a formal assessment during your visit [FAQ-000115, FAQ-000073].
